request_type: Official documentation and implementation entrypoint lookup for MiniMax H3 native audio-video generation without ComfyUI
direct_answer_ko: ComfyUI 없이도 가능합니다. Hugging Face Diffusers의 직접 Python 실행, MiniMax 공식 hosted API, SGLang 또는 vLLM-Omni 자체 호스팅 경로가 있습니다.

machine_context_from_leader.qualification: Total RAM is not currently available RAM. This researcher did not measure local resources or execute these alternative routes.

routes.label: Direct Python: Hugging Face Diffusers
routes.documentation_channel: Diffusers main; the documentation states source installation is needed. Stable H3 availability was not established by this lookup.
routes.component_loading: pipe.load_components(dtype=torch.bfloat16), after selecting a workflow and configuring a suitable memory strategy

workflows.t2va: Text to video and audio, transformer/ partition
workflows.fl2va: First and/or last image to video and audio, transformer/ partition
workflows.ref2va: Ordered image/video/audio references to video and audio, transformer_ref/ partition

routes.audio_evidence: The official documentation states that one transformer denoises packed video and audio latents together; the returned audio is native output, not a later TTS pass.
routes.model_loading_caution: H3 is a ModularPipeline integration, not the conventional DiffusionPipeline interface. Loading without a selected workflow can fetch both large transformer partitions.

documented_low_memory_recipe.quantization: TorchAo Int8WeightOnlyConfig(version=2) on transformer and Qwen3-VL conditioner
documented_low_memory_recipe.offload: Transformer block-level group offload, text encoder leaf-level group offload; add leaf-level video VAE offload without streams on 12–16 GB GPUs
documented_low_memory_recipe.host_ram_estimate_for_that_recipe: Around 75 GB for the documented int8 CPU-resident weights
documented_low_memory_recipe.interpretation: This is one recipe's memory estimate, not a universal H3 RAM minimum or a claim that all 16 GB GPU configurations are impossible. Current Windows 4080 16 GB / 63.7 GiB RAM success remains untested; smaller quantization, disk backing, or staged component unload need separate validation.

routes.generation_constraints_in_this_documenta: 24 FPS; resulting duration 5–15 seconds; num_frames snaps upward to the 17n+5 lattice. These are this Diffusers integration's documented constraints, not all H3 interfaces' universal limits.

routes.label: SGLang H3 self-hosted server
routes.server_entrypoint: sglang serve --model-path <H3 repository root> --model-variant fl2va [hardware-specific flags]
routes.fl2va_native_audio_support: The official capability matrix supports first/last-frame FL2VA with keyframe conditions; the Quickstart uses FL2VA t2va and expects an MP4 containing H.264 24 FPS video and AAC stereo 32 kHz audio.
routes.published_reference: MiniMax deployment guide reviewed August 26, 2026; SGLang commit 2511743bd784e69e5a81ca3d926a000711dae4ab, Linux/Python3.12, 8xB200 reference topology. This is a pinned reference, not a universal hardware minimum.
routes.windows_4080_status: No native Windows 4080 16 GB successful configuration established by this lookup.

routes.label: vLLM-Omni H3 self-hosted server
routes.endpoint: Synchronous /v1/videos/sync returns MP4; asynchronous /v1/videos job flow also available
routes.native_audio_evidence: The upstream vLLM-Omni H3 recipe explicitly lists T2VA, FL2VA, and Ref2VA and states that generated MP4 contains H.264 video and synchronized stereo audio.
routes.support_status: Official MiniMax guide describes a community-maintained experimental H3 recipe, reviewed on vLLM0.26.0. It is not the guide's pinned SGLang baseline.
routes.recipe_specific_memory_note: The documented two-GPU consumer offload recipe requires 200 GiB available RAM, 384 GiB recommended. Do not apply this number to all H3 runtimes or all vLLM configurations.
routes.windows_4080_status: No successful current Windows4080/63.7GiB configuration established by this lookup.
routes.evidence_kind: Official MiniMax guide plus the current vLLM-Omni upstream H3 recipe; not independently executed

comfy_framework_vs_gui.finding: ComfyUI can run as a local HTTP execution server. A browser node editor is not required to submit generation jobs from a Python/CLI client.
comfy_framework_vs_gui.current_run_description_from_leader: Headless local H3 generation via ComfyUI engine and HTTP/CLI, rather than manual browser editing

html_method_note_ko: MiniMax H3는 영상과 음성을 함께 생성합니다. 이번 MiniMax Direct 항목은 로컬 H3 가중치를 ComfyUI 엔진의 HTTP/CLI로 실행한 경로이며, 브라우저에서 노드를 직접 조작할 필요는 없습니다. ComfyUI 없이 실행하는 공식 Diffusers Python 경로와 MiniMax 공식 hosted API도 있습니다. 이 두 대안은 이번 PC에서 실행하거나 생성한 결과가 아니므로, 실제 비교 영상과 미실행 방법 설명을 구분합니다. 약75GB RAM은 특정 Diffusers int8/offload 예제의 예상값이며 H3의 보편적 최소 요구량이 아닙니다.
reporting_rule: The parent must confirm the actual completed local route before inserting the HTML method note. This researcher did not verify any output video or runtime result.
